persona: Talkative and well organised; gives most of the story in one go and has every document ready. Still a bit shaken but clear.
initial_message: Hi, I need to lodge a claim. Saturday night 26 September about 8.40pm I was driving home along Driftwood Test Crescent in Waiatarua in that storm and came round a bend into a big pine tree that had come down across the road. I braked but slid into it. Both front airbags went off, the bonnet and bumper are wrecked and coolant was pouring out, so Long Reach Towing took it away and it's now at Ridgeway Collision Repairs in Henderson. They've given me a quote and said an assessor needs to look at it because of the airbags. Nobody was hurt, I was on my own, and the guy in the car behind me stopped and gave me his number. It's my 2022 Hyundai Kona, rego TST-040.

facts.incident.description: I was driving home in heavy rain and wind at about 50 km/h. Around a bend a large pine tree had fallen right across the road. I braked hard but the car slid on the wet road into the trunk. Both front airbags went off and coolant poured out. The driver behind me stopped, helped me put my hazard lights and triangle out, and rang the council about the tree.
facts.incident.cause: Slid into a tree that had fallen across the road in a storm
facts.loss.description: Front end crushed, bonnet buckled, both headlights broken, radiator holed, both front airbags deployed

facts.if_asked_about_the_tree: It was a big pine that came down in the wind. The council crew cleared it later that night. I don't know whose tree it was; it was on the roadside.
facts.if_asked_about_assessor: Ridgeway said the insurer's assessor needs to see it because the airbags went off. It is at their Henderson workshop.
facts.if_asked_about_passengers: No, I was on my own.

triage.rationale: The car cannot be driven, was towed and needs an assessor because the airbags deployed. Quote total NZD 11,891.00 including GST, over the threshold. Nobody hurt; the witness stopped to help and is not involved; the fallen tree is not another party. All materials are present and readable. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).
